description: Parse a measurement or convert it to a target unit. Supports mixed measurements such as 5 ft 11 in. Amount is a decimal string. Without to, returns the canonical unit for its type. Ambiguous input returns valid false, reason and choices. Use measure_units to discover accepted units. Pooled request, no separate check charge.

measure.description: Measurement to parse, e.g. 5 ft 11 in or 10 kg

system.description: Resolve an ambiguous customary unit using the stated system

to.description: Target unit, e.g. cm or lb

name: measure
